prompt: Create a full-body photorealistic fashion portrait of a young East Asian woman standing in the middle of a quiet Japanese residential street on a bright summer day. She has dark brown-black long hair styled half-up in a loose messy ponytail with soft bangs and wispy strands, a slim build, fair skin, and a calm slightly serious expression while looking directly at the camera. She wears oversized translucent pale-pink square glasses, a simple white sleeveless mini slip dress with thin spaghetti straps, and chunky lace-up combat boots in mint turquoise. Her hands are gently clasped in front of her hips, feet apart in a relaxed pose. The setting is a narrow suburban street in Japan with low houses and apartment buildings, concrete walls, utility poles, overhead power lines, road markings, and exactly two vending machines on the right side: one blue machine and one white machine filled with colorful drinks. Use a low-to-mid eye-level camera, vertical 9:16 composition, centered subject, 35mm realistic lens feel, crisp sunlight, hard shadows on asphalt, vivid blue sky with large fluffy cumulus clouds, distant hills at the end of the road, high-detail skin and fabric texture, natural color grading, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, ultra-realistic editorial street photography. Avoid text overlays, logos, watermarks, extra people, distorted anatomy, or unrealistic proportions.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实的全身时尚人像，画面中一位年轻的东亚女性站在阳光明媚的夏日午后，位于一条宁静的日本住宅街道中央。她留着 深棕黑色 的长发，发型为随性的半扎马尾，配有柔和的刘海和碎发；她身材苗条，肤色白皙，神情平静且略带严肃，直视镜头。她佩戴着大框透明浅粉色方形眼镜，身穿一件简约的 白色 无袖吊带迷你裙，脚蹬一双 薄荷绿 的厚底系带马丁靴。她的双手轻扣在髋部前方，双脚分开，姿态放松。背景是一条狭窄的日本郊区街道，两侧有低矮的房屋和公寓楼、混凝土墙、电线杆、架空电线、道路标线，右侧设有两台自动售货机：一台蓝色和一台白色，里面装满了色彩缤纷的饮料。采用中低视平线拍摄，9:16 竖构图，主体居中，35mm 真实镜头感，明亮的阳光，沥青路面上的硬投影，湛蓝的天空点缀着巨大的蓬松积云，道路尽头可见远山，皮肤和织物纹理细节丰富，自然色彩分级，浅至中等景深，超写实街头时尚摄影。避免文字叠加、标志、水印、多余人物、解剖结构扭曲或比例不真实的情况。
